assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The intermittent nature of these symptoms and the need to evaluate for potential arrhythmias contributing to hemodynamic instability.
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to correlate clinical events with cardiac rhythm disturbances.
CPT code 93247 represents this long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study.
The long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study is medically necessary to document the relationship between the patient's symptoms and underlying cardiac rhythm disturbances.
